meta.name: Sins of Kujo
meta.description:
From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 2 Apr 2026 · Japan · Language: Japanese · 40 min
Studio: TBS Sparkle, TBS · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

On your server — Audio: Japanese

videos.title: The Worth of a Leg
videos.overview: At Kujo Law Office, an eccentric attorney takes on a hit-and-run case as a favor to gang leader Mibu — raising questions from his curious new partner.

videos.title: The Dignity of the Vulnerable
videos.overview: A flashback reveals a past connection between the two lawyers. Kujo proposes a risky strategy that gives a client confidence to break his negative cycle.

videos.title: The Dignity of the Vulnerable 2
videos.overview: Sogabe makes a firm decision to break his situation — and goes to prison. After a run-in with his estranged brother, Kujo meets with a suspicious CEO.

videos.title: Family Ties
videos.overview: A disturbing case of fraud and coercion at a nursing home leads Kujo to confront his former mentor, Yamashiro, in a bid to stop his reckless actions.

videos.title: Family Ties 2
videos.overview: Kujo takes on a new request where a past conflict between Mibu and his boss Kyogoku, the young leader of the Kyogoku gang, comes to light.

videos.title: Remnants of Consumption
videos.overview: Kujo agrees to defend Kyogoku's associate in a case fronted by his former classmate. Meanwhile, a troubled girl tries to enter the adult video industry.

videos.title: Remnants of Consumption 2
videos.overview: After her parents' selfish actions, Shizuku turns to Shuto for support but instead finds more manipulation, pushing her to the edge as tragedy strikes.

videos.title: The Undetected Truth
videos.overview: Karasuma presses Mibu about his connection to Detective Arashiyama's case and goes out of his way to protect Kujo from any further involvement.

videos.title: The Undetected Truth 2
videos.overview: After Arashiyama questions Koyama about a past murder case, Kujo comes under fire from the detective who threatens to take him down, along with Mibu.

videos.title: Chain of Violence
videos.overview: Karasuma and Kujo contemplate their partnership as their future hangs in the balance. Inukai's actions draw Mibu and Kyogoku into a risky situation.
